'''Borless acid''' was a type of [[Acid/Legends|acid]]. Borless acid was used in the metal-jacketed cartridge ammunition fired from the [[Kelvarek Consolidated Arms/Legends|Kelvarek Consolidated Arms]] [[Dissuader KD-30]].
